# DSPIN Regulatory Responses — WildR vs SPF

## Overview

We fit program-level D-SPIN models on snRNA-seq nuclei for every hard-pass Allen **supertype × tissue** unit (AMY and HYP), treating microbiome status as a physiological perturbation (SPF = control; WildR = perturbed). Each animal is one DSPIN condition (`sample_id`). This notebook is display-only: it reads fit artifacts from [data/interim/dspin/]{.path}.

```{r}
#| label: load-artifacts
#| include: false

manifest <- read_csv(file.path(dspin_dir, "full_manifest.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(rank)
fit_summary <- read_csv(file.path(dspin_dir, "fit_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

unit_path_from_row <- function(row) {
  if ("unit_path" %in% names(row) && !is.na(row$unit_path[[1]])) return(row$unit_path[[1]])
  glue("{dspin_dir}/{row$tissue[[1]]}__{row$supertype_label[[1]]}")
}

read_unit_responses <- function(unit_path) {
  rel <- file.path(unit_path, "relative_responses.csv")
  meta <- file.path(unit_path, "sample_meta.csv")
  if (!file.exists(rel)) return(NULL)
  df <- read_csv(rel, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(meta)) {
    sm <- read_csv(meta, show_col_types = FALSE)
    df <- df %>% left_join(sm, by = "sample_id")
  }
  df
}

resp_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(manifest)), function(i) {
  sp <- unit_path_from_row(manifest[i, , drop = FALSE])
  df <- read_unit_responses(sp)
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  df$tissue <- manifest$tissue[[i]]
  df$supertype_label <- manifest$supertype_label[[i]]
  df$supertype_name <- manifest$supertype_name[[i]]
  df$rank <- manifest$rank[[i]]
  df$unit_path <- sp
  df
})
resp_long <- bind_rows(resp_list)

# Per-unit WildR response strength (for overview ranking)
unit_strength <- resp_long %>%
  filter(microbiome == "WildR" | (is.na(microbiome) & !isTRUE(if_control))) %>%
  group_by(tissue, supertype_label, supertype_name, rank) %>%
  summarise(
    n_wildr = n_distinct(sample_id),
    mean_abs_h = mean(abs(relative_h), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_h = max(abs(relative_h), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_h))

stars <- resp_long %>%
  filter(microbiome == "WildR" | is.na(microbiome)) %>%
  group_by(tissue, supertype_name, supertype_label, program_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_wildr_samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
    mean_h = mean(relative_h, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_h = sd(relative_h, na.rm = TRUE),
    same_sign = n_distinct(sign(relative_h[relative_h != 0 & is.finite(relative_h)])) <= 1,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_wildr_samples >= 2, same_sign, is.finite(mean_h)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(mean_h)))

write_csv(unit_strength, file.path(tbl_dir, "unit_response_strength.csv"))
write_csv(stars, file.path(tbl_dir, "star_programs.csv"))

# DAVID program annotations (optional until array completes)
david_files <- list.files(
  dspin_dir, pattern = "^program_annotations_david\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE
)
if (length(david_files)) {
  david_ann <- bind_rows(lapply(david_files, read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
    mutate(
      program_id = as.character(program_id),
      program_label = ifelse(
        !is.na(top_term) & nzchar(top_term),
        paste0(program_id, " · ", str_trunc(top_term, 40)),
        program_id
      )
    )
  write_csv(david_ann, file.path(tbl_dir, "program_annotations_david_all.csv"))
} else {
  david_ann <- tibble()
}

stars_ann <- if (nrow(david_ann)) {
  stars %>%
    left_join(
      david_ann %>% select(tissue, supertype_label, program_id, top_term, top_category, top_pvalue, n_terms_p05),
      by = c("tissue", "supertype_label", "program_id")
    )
} else {
  stars %>% mutate(top_term = NA_character_, top_category = NA_character_,
                   top_pvalue = NA_real_, n_terms_p05 = NA_integer_)
}
write_csv(stars_ann, file.path(tbl_dir, "star_programs_david.csv"))
```

## Background

Differential expression (MAST) and Augur score *which genes / types* shift with microbiome, but can look muted when the effect is a redistribution of coordinated programs rather than a few huge gene hits. D-SPIN ([Jiang et al., *Cell* 2026](https://www.cell.com/cell/fulltext/S0092-8674(26)00463-0)) estimates a shared program interaction network **J** and condition response vectors **h**, so we can ask whether WildR systematically pushes program activity relative to SPF *within* each Allen type.

**Wiring (locked):** snRNA-seq only; paths use filesystem-safe `supertype_label` (`tissue__CS20230722_SUPT_####`); `sample_id = sample`; SPF = control; `batch = tissue`. No extra per-cell QC beyond project `keep_cell`.

## Results

```{r}
#| label: cell-fig-cohort
#| fig-show: hide
#| include: false

p_cohort <- manifest %>%
  mutate(
    short = str_trunc(supertype_name, 28),
    lab = fct_reorder(paste(tissue, short, sep = " · "), n_cells)
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 24) %>%
  select(lab, tissue, n_SPF, n_WildR) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(n_SPF, n_WildR), names_to = "microbiome", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(microbiome = str_remove(microbiome, "n_")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(n, lab, fill = microbiome)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(SPF = "#27455C", WildR = "#FF6C0C")) +
  labs(x = "Nuclei", y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "Largest / top-ranked units (n = 24 of 140)") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "cohort_top24.png"), p_cohort, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
```

::: {.figure-card .fig-wide}
![](../figures/DSPIN/snRNASeq/cohort_top24.png)

::: {.fig-caption}
[**Figure 1.**]{.fig-num} Nuclei counts for the top-ranked hard-pass units (by MAST/Augur score used for pilot prioritization). Full cohort is 140 units (AMY 65, HYP 75); each unit retains all `keep_cell` nuclei of that Allen label in that tissue.
:::

::: {.takeaways}
**Key takeaways**

- Every plotted unit has balanced SPF and WildR representation by construction (`hard_pass`).
- Cell counts span ~450–28k nuclei; larger units (e.g. MOL, L2/3 IT) dominate total N but are not automatically the strongest DSPIN responders.
:::

[Source: cell `cell-fig-cohort`](#cell-fig-cohort){.provenance}
:::

[B]{.panel-label}
![](../figures/DSPIN/snRNASeq/strength_vs_ncells.png)
:::

::: {.fig-caption}
[**Figure 2.**]{.fig-num} Global view of DSPIN relative responses. (A) Top 30 units by mean absolute WildR relative **h** across programs. (B) All 140 units: response strength vs nuclei; point size = number of MAST DE genes (padj < 0.1). Full table: [tables/DSPIN/unit_response_strength.csv]{.path}.
:::

::: {.takeaways}
**Key takeaways**

- Strong DSPIN shifts are not simply the largest types — some mid-sized hypothalamic and amygdalar types rank high.
- Units with many MAST hits are not guaranteed high |h|; DSPIN can highlight coordinated program moves where single-gene lists are diffuse (and vice versa).
:::

[Source: cell `cell-fig-strength`](#cell-fig-strength){.provenance}
:::

```{r}
#| label: cell-fig-heatmap
#| fig-show: hide
#| include: false

show <- unit_strength %>% slice_head(n = n_heatmap_units)
heat_df <- resp_long %>%
  semi_join(show, by = c("tissue", "supertype_label")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(relative_h), microbiome == "WildR" | is.na(microbiome)) %>%
  mutate(
    unit = paste(tissue, str_trunc(supertype_name, 28), sep = " · "),
    unit = factor(unit, levels = paste(show$tissue, str_trunc(show$supertype_name, 28), sep = " · ")),
    program_id = as.character(program_id)
  )

if (nrow(david_ann)) {
  heat_df <- heat_df %>%
    left_join(
      david_ann %>% select(tissue, supertype_label, program_id, program_label),
      by = c("tissue", "supertype_label", "program_id")
    ) %>%
    mutate(program_axis = coalesce(program_label, program_id))
} else {
  heat_df <- heat_df %>% mutate(program_axis = program_id)
}

# Shared color scale across panels
lim <- max(abs(heat_df$relative_h), na.rm = TRUE)

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(sample_id, program_axis, fill = relative_h)) +
  geom_tile(color = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~unit, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim), name = "rel. h") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    title = if (nrow(david_ann)) {
      "WildR relative h (rows labeled by DAVID top term when available)"
    } else {
      "WildR relative program responses (top units by |h|)"
    }
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "heatmap_top_units.png"), p_heat, width = 12, height = 11, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
```

::: {.figure-card .fig-wide}
![](../figures/DSPIN/snRNASeq/heatmap_top_units.png)

::: {.fig-caption}
[**Figure 3.**]{.fig-num} Relative program responses **h** for WildR animals in the six strongest units (by mean |h|). Rows = programs (20 / unit), labeled `P# · DAVID term` when annotations are available; columns = animals. Shared diverging scale centered at 0 (SPF baseline).
:::

::: {.takeaways}
**Key takeaways**

- Look for programs with the same sign across ≥2 WildR animals — those are the robust “star” candidates below.
- Animal-to-animal discord within a program is a feature, not a bug: it flags single-sample driven fits.
:::

[Source: cell `cell-fig-heatmap`](#cell-fig-heatmap){.provenance}

  }
}

### DAVID gene-program annotations

```{r}
#| label: cell-fig-david
#| fig-show: hide
#| include: false

has_david <- nrow(david_ann) > 0 && any(!is.na(david_ann$top_term))

if (has_david) {
  # Star programs with strongest |h| and a DAVID term
  star_david <- stars_ann %>%
    filter(!is.na(top_term), is.finite(mean_h)) %>%
    mutate(
      lab = paste(tissue, str_trunc(supertype_name, 24), program_id, sep = " · "),
      lab = fct_reorder(lab, abs(mean_h))
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = 25)

  p_star_david <- ggplot(star_david, aes(mean_h, lab, fill = tissue)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = str_trunc(top_term, 36), hjust = ifelse(mean_h >= 0, -0.05, 1.05)),
      size = 2.6, color = "#333333"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(AMY = "#27455C", HYP = "#FF6C0C")) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.35, 0.35))) +
    labs(
      x = "Mean relative h (WildR)",
      y = NULL, fill = NULL,
      title = "Star programs with DAVID putative functions"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

  ggsave(
    file.path(fig_dir, "star_programs_david.png"), p_star_david,
    width = 12, height = 8.5, dpi = 180, bg = "white"
  )

  # Recurrent DAVID terms among annotated programs (all units)
  term_freq <- david_ann %>%
    filter(!is.na(top_term), nzchar(top_term)) %>%
    count(top_term, tissue, name = "n_programs") %>%
    group_by(top_term) %>%
    mutate(n_total = sum(n_programs)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(n_total >= 3) %>%
    mutate(top_term = fct_reorder(str_trunc(top_term, 50), n_total))

  p_terms <- term_freq %>%
    ggplot(aes(n_programs, top_term, fill = tissue)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(AMY = "#27455C", HYP = "#FF6C0C")) +
    labs(
      x = "# annotated programs",
      y = NULL, fill = NULL,
      title = "Recurrent DAVID top terms (≥3 programs)"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))

  ggsave(
    file.path(fig_dir, "david_term_frequency.png"), p_terms,
    width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 180, bg = "white"
  )
}
```

### Cross-method note

```{r}
#| label: cell-cross-method
#| echo: false

mast_path <- file.path(data_path, "mast/snRNASeq/supertype_mast_signif_hits_2026-01-04.rds")
mast <- if (file.exists(mast_path)) readRDS(mast_path) %>% as_tibble() else tibble()

bridge_rows <- list()
top_for_bridge <- unit_strength %>% slice_head(n = 15)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_for_bridge))) {
  sp <- file.path(dspin_dir, paste0(top_for_bridge$tissue[[i]], "__", top_for_bridge$supertype_label[[i]]))
  pg_path <- file.path(sp, "programs_genes.csv")
  if (!file.exists(pg_path)) next
  pg <- read_csv(pg_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (!nrow(pg)) next
  sl <- resp_long %>%
    filter(
      tissue == top_for_bridge$tissue[[i]],
      supertype_label == top_for_bridge$supertype_label[[i]],
      microbiome == "WildR" | is.na(microbiome)
    )
  top_prog <- sl %>%
    group_by(program_id) %>%
    summarise(mean_abs_h = mean(abs(relative_h), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abs_h)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 3)
  prog_genes <- pg %>% filter(program_id %in% top_prog$program_id)
  mast_i <- mast %>%
    filter(
      tissue == top_for_bridge$tissue[[i]],
      supertype_name == top_for_bridge$supertype_name[[i]],
      p_adjust < 0.1
    ) %>%
    mutate(gene = str_remove(primerid, "-GRCm39$"))
  ov <- prog_genes %>%
    mutate(gene = str_remove(gene, "-GRCm39$")) %>%
    inner_join(mast_i %>% select(gene, coef, p_adjust), by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(
      tissue = top_for_bridge$tissue[[i]],
      supertype_name = top_for_bridge$supertype_name[[i]]
    )
  bridge_rows[[length(bridge_rows) + 1]] <- ov
}
bridge <- bind_rows(bridge_rows)
write_csv(bridge, file.path(tbl_dir, "dspin_mast_overlap_top15.csv"))

cat(
  "DSPIN program genes ∩ MAST (padj<0.1) among top-15 |h| units: ",
  nrow(bridge), " gene–program hits. ",
  "SCENIC production regulons are tissue × class (not supertype) — treat as narrative bridge only.\n",
  sep = ""
)
if (nrow(bridge)) {
  knitr::kable(
    bridge %>%
      arrange(p_adjust) %>%
      select(tissue, supertype_name, program_id, gene, coef, p_adjust) %>%
      head(20),
    caption = "Example DSPIN ↔ MAST gene overlaps (top 20 by padj)."
  )
}
```

## Next Steps

- Prioritize **star** programs (table above) for follow-up: gene membership, MAST overlap, and SCENIC class-level regulons in the parent Allen class.
- For units where |h| is high but MAST is quiet (Figure 2B), treat DSPIN as a hypothesis generator for coordinated shifts DEG lists missed.
- Optional v2: gene-level DSPIN or SCENIC-informed program priors (design Approach C).
- Re-render after DAVID annotations land (`program_annotations_david.csv` per unit).

## Code & Provenance {.code-appendix}

All executable logic for this HTML lives in the labelled chunks above (`cell-fig-*`, `cell-tbl-*`). Fit artifacts were produced outside this notebook by:

1. `notebooks/R_scripts/export_dspin_h5ads.R` + `rank_dspin_pilots.R` (paths keyed by `supertype_label`)
2. `notebooks/python_scripts/dspin_prep_filtered.py` (HVG → `filtered.h5ad`)
3. `notebooks/shell_scripts/run_dspin_fit_array.sh` → `dspin_fit_one.py`
4. `notebooks/shell_scripts/run_dspin_david_array.sh` → `dspin_david_one.py` (DAVID; mouse)

```{r}
#| label: gated-analysis
#| eval: !expr run_analysis
#| echo: true

# Submit DAVID annotation array for all full_manifest units.
# Requires DAVID-registered email in env DAVID_TOKEN or file .secrets/david_token
# (register at https://davidbioinformatics.nih.gov/).
token_file <- file.path(wkdir, ".secrets/david_token")
has_token <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("DAVID_TOKEN")) || file.exists(token_file)
stopifnot(has_token)

script <- file.path(wkdir, "notebooks/shell_scripts/run_dspin_david_array.sh")
cmd <- if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("DAVID_TOKEN"))) {
  paste("sbatch --export=ALL,DAVID_TOKEN", shQuote(script))
} else {
  paste("sbatch", shQuote(script))
}
message("Running: ", cmd)
system(cmd)
```
